claims: Rick Pitino is the head coach of the St. John's Red Storm men's basketball team.
Rick Pitino took the position in 2023.
Rick Pitino is a Hall of Fame coach.
Rick Pitino led St. John's Red Storm men's basketball team to multiple NCAA Tournament appearances within his first three seasons.
Rick Pitino agreed to a six-year deal to become head coach in March 2023.
Rick Pitino led the team to top seeds in the Big East.
Rick Pitino tied for 3rd all-time in NCAA career wins as of March 2026.
Rick Pitino has 903+ NCAA career wins as of March 2026.
Rick Pitino is assisted by associate head coach Steve Masiello.
Joe Tartamella is the head coach of the St. John's Women's Basketball team
